desc: Name five things you see, four you hear, three you feel, two you smell, one you taste to anchor in the present.

name: Name Three Sounds
desc: Pause and listen until you can identify three distinct sounds around you.

name: Name That Tune
desc: Call to mind a song and hum or tap its rhythm. What song is it?

name: Look Far
desc: Lift your gaze to the farthest point you can see and let your eyes rest on the distance.

name: Palm the Eyes
desc: Cup your warm palms gently over closed eyes and rest in the darkness for a breath or two.

name: Palm the Ears
desc: Cover your ears with your palms and notice the muffled quiet before releasing.

name: Three Deep Breaths
desc: Take three slow, full breaths, letting each exhale be longer than the inhale.

name: Deepest Exhale
desc: Breathe out as completely as you can, emptying the lungs before the next natural breath comes in.

name: Hold Your Breath
desc: Take a comfortable breath and hold briefly, noticing the stillness, then release.

name: Shoulder Stretch
desc: Roll or reach the shoulders to release held tension across the upper back.

name: Neck Roll
desc: Slowly circle the head to loosen the neck and ease mental tightness.

name: Arms Up High
desc: Reach both arms overhead and lengthen the whole torso toward the ceiling.

name: Lift the Legs
desc: Raise one or both legs to wake up the lower body and shift circulation.

name: Stand Up
desc: Stand up for a minute and let the blood flow back into the lower body.

name: Take a Stretch
desc: Stretch however your body is asking to. What does your body need now?

name: Above and Below
desc: Reach up high, then fold down low, moving awareness through the full vertical range.

name: To My Right and Left
desc: Turn or reach to each side to open the lateral body and widen your attention.

name: Figure Four
desc: Cross one ankle over the opposite knee to open the hip while seated or standing. Lean over the bent leg.

name: Side Bend
desc: Lean gently to one side and then the other to lengthen the waist.

name: Make Me Taller
desc: Grow upward through the spine, imagining a thread lifting the crown of the head.

name: Crouch and Bend
desc: Lower into a crouch and fold, releasing the back and legs toward the ground.

name: Touch Your Toes
desc: Fold forward and reach toward your toes, letting the spine hang.

name: Knuckle Flex
desc: Open and close the hands, flexing the knuckles to bring intelligence into the fingers.

name: Wiggle Your Toes
desc: Wake up the feet by wiggling the toes and feeling contact with the floor.

name: Roll the Ankles
desc: Roll or rotate the ankles to bring in blood flow and attention.

name: Jump Up and Down
desc: A few light jumps to raise energy and shake off stuck attention.

name: Turn in a Circle
desc: Rotate slowly all the way around to take in the whole space from where you stand.

name: Step Away
desc: Physically leave your spot for a moment or two to break state and return with fresh eyes.

name: Take an Office Lap
desc: Walk one slow lap around the office, floor, or room to move the body and shift circulation.

name: Name That Emotion
desc: Pause to name whatever emotions are present right now. We don't judge.

name: Where in My Body?
desc: Notice where in your body your attention goes when you start thinking about it.

name: Scan the Body
desc: Sweep attention slowly from head to toe, noticing each region as you pass.

name: What Surprised You The Most?
desc: Recall the moment that most surprised you recently and sit with it.

name: Name Three Thoughts
desc: Notice and name three thoughts passing through your mind to see them clearly.

name: Draw Your Thoughts
desc: Put whatever is in your head onto paper as quick marks, shapes, or drawing.

name: Doodle Maker
desc: Let the pen wander freely for a minute with no goal.

name: Draw A Picture
desc: Sketch a simple image of anything to engage the hand and eye.

name: Who's That?
desc: Bring to mind a person who matters to you and hold them in awareness for a moment.

name: Prompt Haiku
desc: Create a quick haiku or poem in the time it takes your prompt to return.

name: Watch the Verb
desc: Read the Pondering, Conjuring, Noodling, Divining and notice what you feel about the machine's working.

name: Spinner Breath
desc: Match one slow breath to three counts of the loading spinner. Waiting becomes the practice.

name: Guess the Reply
desc: Before the answer lands, silently predict what it will say, then notice how attached you were to being right.

name: Thank the Machine
desc: Offer a quiet word of thanks to the model while it churns, and observe whether it feels sincere, or absurd.

name: Out-Wait the Robot
desc: Resolve to sit perfectly still until the reply arrives. Turns empty time into empty practice (so zen).

name: Who's Working Harder?
desc: Notice that something somewhere is doing a great deal of computing on your behalf while you simply sit and breathe.

name: Name the Verb You'd Use
desc: Invent the status word you wish it showed for this moment: Procrastinating, Overthinking, Avoiding Lunch. Write them down.
